headline: VisionQuest brings back a familiar cameo
post:

In the Marvel Cinematic Universe series, Dale plays a lonely crypto-bro caught in a bad situation in Madripoor. It is a hilarious running gag for fans to enjoy.

Did you catch this cameo appearance? 🤔

headline: Vintage Star Wars Yak Face Worth Thousands
post:
Have you seen how much rare vintage Star Wars toys are going for lately? An original Canadian release of the Yak Face action figure from the Power of the Force collection has a starting bid of $7,500 at Hakes.

Because it skipped the United States, featured bilingual packaging, and received a top grade, this rare collectible is worth a massive premium today! 🐫

Would you ever spend thousands of dollars on a vintage action figure?

post:

headline: Magneto's New Superpowers Revealed in Marvel Comics
post:
The Master of Magnetism has unlocked major new abilities in the latest comic lore. According to Screen Rant, the X-Men character's mutant gifts are now directly tied to his immune system. This means his body can automatically defend itself and unilaterally weaponize magnetism without conscious thought. ⚡

In Fantastic Four #18, the FF shrink down to fix Magneto's DNA and help solve a mysterious illness. During this microscopic mission, they encounter invisible gravitons and electromagnetic attacks generated by Magneto's unconscious body. Beast explains that this allows the mutant to fight off threats without even knowing they are there.

This incredible twist suggests that Omega-level mutants have a totally different relationship with their powers. It even hints that knocking Magneto unconscious might not take him out of a fight. What do you think of these huge upgrades?

#XMen #Marvel #Magneto
original_title: Marvel Confirms Permanent New Superpowers for X-Men's Magneto
